items.summary: Risk disposition: conditional for ordinary reversible fleet growth; blocked for SearchWoot public beta or full launch; counsel_required for upstream data rights, jurisdiction-specific privacy treatment, notification processing, vendor/DPA terms, and any affiliate or advertising expansion. Recommendation: retain only updates to existing work items, keep SearchWoot private, preserve unknowns, and do not create new production, telemetry, spend, outreach, or launch work. Evidence: compliance is a technical baseline with 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown sites; analytics has source-permission gaps; revenue contains $4.92 aggregate unattributed commission; operations and fleet-doctor sweeps are unavailable. These gaps do not independently block ordinary growth where existing consent, disclosures, claims, provenance, rights, and platform boundaries are preserved.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active. Progress: 0 of 4 legal tasks closed. Source-rights task remains blocked: API access is evidenced, but written permission for storage, derivatives, public display, caching, alerts, affiliate use, or advertising is not. Data-flow/retention, GA4 consent/configuration, and logs/vendors/incident tasks remain evidence_needed. Next evidence action: attach one read-only evidence bundle covering alert data fields, identifiers, retention, deletion, correction, access, notification consent/unsubscribe behavior, GA4 settings, log fields, vendor terms/DPA coverage, and incident/request procedures; separately prepare the field-level rights matrix and unsent permission request for human counsel and owner review.

Data-use dispositions: Woot API deal and price-history data = blocked; missing current written permission or agreement, field-level rights, permitted caching/display/alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, and takedown terms. User alert rules and sync results = evidence_needed; missing data inventory, retention, deletion/correction/access workflow, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe evidence. GA4 analytics = evidence_needed; missing deployed consent/withdrawal capture, property and data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdiction-specific review. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data = evidence_needed; missing log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor/DPA review, and incident/request procedures. Smallest next actions are respectively: produce the rights matrix and draft request; produce the data-flow/retention table; capture existing consent and GA4 configuration without enabling tracking; inventory logs, vendors, and incident procedures.

Claims, affiliate disclosure, copyright/trademark provenance, platform-policy, regulated, and age-sensitive review remains conditional/evidence_needed where site-specific evidence is absent. Do not infer adult status, regulated use, rights, or compliance from domain names or incomplete telemetry. No go-live proposal is supported.
